description: Dhaka (Bangladesh) - Land Use / Land Cover Maps (ESA EO4SD-Urban) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) information product over Dhaka (Bangladesh) contains spatial explicit information about the different land covers / uses for current (2017) and past (2006) dates. The level of detail for the classification scheme mainly relies on the input data sources. Coverage: Bangladesh. It has 10 files in SHP ZIP, HTML, PDF. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
